triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: Alyosha went towards the cathedral square to the widow Morozov’s house to see Grushenka, who had sent Fenya to him early in the morning with an urgent message begging him to come.

triples.subject: Fenya
triples.quote: When it got dark and the shutters were closed, Fenya asked her mistress: “Is the gentleman going to stay the night, mistress?”

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: the calamity that had overtaken the poor girl, betrothed to a man who had been arrested for a terrible crime, almost at the instant of their betrothal

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: The object of that uneasiness was the same as ever—Katerina Ivanovna, of whom Grushenka had even raved when she lay in delirium.

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: We quarreled again, would you believe it? Whenever I go we quarrel.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: Only fancy, he is jealous of the Pole. ‘Why are you keeping him?’ he said.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: He even took it into his head to be jealous of Kuzma last week.

triples.subject: Pan Mussyalovitch
triples.quote: Grushenka had received many such letters, accompanied by such receipts, from her former lover during the fortnight of her convalescence.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: how she had ordered the best counsel, the most learned one, too. So he loves her, if

triples.subject: Maximov
triples.quote: When the homeless old man returned with Grushenka from Mokroe two months before, he had simply stayed on and was still staying with her.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: No, it’s not Rakitin; it’s his brother Ivan Fyodorovitch upsetting him.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: First, that he loves you, loves you more than any one in the world, and you only, believe me.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: So he loves her, if he’ll praise her to my face, more shame to him!

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: A week ago he suddenly told me that Ivan was in love with Katerina, because he often goes to see her.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: He’s treated me badly himself, so he attacked me, to make out I am in fault first and to throw it all on me.

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: You wait, I’ll make it hot for Katerina at the trial! I’ll just say a word then ... I’ll tell everything then!

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: They want to prove that Mitya’s mad and committed the murder when he didn’t know what he was doing
